study_type: posthoc secondary chemical stress diagnostic; all source outcomes previously seen, rules locked before new regional performance computation
region_justification: Operational high-MW, polar and amide-rich stress regions motivated by ADC release chemistry; not an empirically validated ADC applicability domain. No threshold tuning or choosing favorable region results.
ADC_panel: 14 unique source identities for coverage description only; no label transfer or accuracy estimate. Counts apply to model-standardized representations.
sources: ASAP 56 unique compounds with previously defined median-log2ER aggregate; posthoc sensitivity population
endpoint: Within each source measured ER>=2 study-specific weak direction; no gene-isolated substrate truth transfer
count_unit: unique chemical entity within source; concentrations and repeats never counted as new molecules; sources analyzed separately
identity_policy: exclude source/model exact or connectivity development overlaps; retain raw and effective denominator audit
gate_interpretation: Reporting safeguards for small denominators, not sample-size power guarantees or confirmatory validation
policies: full frozen v0.4 at native accepted k within each region
v0.1 absolute distance from0.5 selects same k within region
v0.3 absolute distance from0.5 selects same k within region
selection_rule: fixed UID tie-break; no force-fill of full-selector abstentions; k=0 remains0
underqualified_results: n, class count, selected n, coverage, source/scaffold counts and confusion counts only; performance-comparison metrics null with reasons

bootstrap.unit: whole Murcko scaffold within source and region
bootstrap.paired_delta: within draw full minus each margin
bootstrap.less_valid_draws: CI null; counts remain visible, no survivorship interval

inference_limits: not evidence of equivalence from non-significance
